description: This file defines configuration options related to hardware features (such as math capabilities, floating point units, hardware multiply/divide support) for the MicroBlaze architecture within a build system. It specifies feature validity, conflicts, compiler arguments, target FPU configuration, and package architecture formatting.

methods.name: bb.utils.contains_any
methods.description: Checks if any of the specified features are present in the TUNE_FEATURES variable.

methods.name: bb.utils.contains
methods.description: Checks if a specific feature is present in the TUNE_FEATURES variable.
